Dechlorination of chlorinated effluent is accomplished with sodium bisulfite (NaHSO 3).
Sludge from the secondary treatment processes at the Fallbrook WRP is aerobically digested...
Dewatered sludge is fed to a thermal dryer to meet Class A biosolids requirements.
Class A biosolids are utilized as fertilizer by local farmers.
During high flows or emergency operating or maintenance periods, a 1.2-million-gallon (MG) secondary effluent equalization basin is available for temporary storage.
Additionally, the Fallbrook WRP has a 1.0-MG recycled water storage basin.
